files.title: Files

version.heading: SHOW THE FILE FROM
version.note: Only versions that exist are listed.
version.noteFrom: Opened from {{task}}. Only versions that exist are listed.

goTo.none: No file's name holds what you typed.

files.openAtCommit: A commit's file is not on disk; show the checkout's or the run's worktree's version to open it.
files.openRuns: Orchester does not open a file that your system would run instead of showing.
files.personOnly: Only a person's click does this; automation cannot.
files.openFailed: The file could not be opened; the app's log says why.

noFile.title: Choose a file
noFile.detail: Pick a file in the tree, or find one by name.

gone.worktreeUnnamed: The run's worktree no longer exists
gone.worktreeDetail: It was removed after the run ended, so this file can't be shown as the run left it. The project's checkout has the version that is there now.
gone.revisionDetail: The repository no longer holds this commit, so the file can't be shown as it was there.
gone.baseDetail: The project's checkout is not on a branch, so there is no base branch to show.

binary.title: This file isn't text
binary.detail: {{name}} is a binary file, so it isn't shown here. Open in editor opens it with the program your system uses for it.

tooLarge.title: This file is too large to show
tooLarge.detail: {{name}} is {{size}}. Files up to {{limit}} are shown here so the page opens at once; open this one in your editor.

refused.title: This path is outside the project
refused.detail: “{{path}}” leads out of {{folder}}. Files open here only from inside the project's folder or a run's worktree: a path with “..”, an absolute path, or a link or junction that leads out is refused.

missing.title: This file is not in this version
